newsitem.title: UK: B.A.T down as New York sues tobacco firms.
newsitem.headline: B.A.T down as New York sues tobacco firms.

text.p: Shares in B.A.T Industries Plc and Imperial Tobacco Plc dropped on Monday after the New York state attorney sued six major tobacco companies, accusing them of deceiving New Yorkers about the dangers of smoking.
B.A.T was down 6-1/2p at 489 by 1558 GMT while Imperial was down 3-1/2p at 384-1/2.
The six named in the lawsuit filed in the Manhattan State Supreme Court, accusing firms of "illegally luring teenagers into smoking cigarettes," included Brown & Williamson, the U.S. unit of B.A.T.

"For decades, tobacco companies have engaged in a conspiracy to mislead, deceive and confuse New Yorkers about the harmful, debilitating health effects of their powerfully-addictive products," said New York attorney general Dennis Vacco.
However B.A.T dismissed the lawsuit as a "copycat" of a number of claims already launched and said it believed it was not legally viable.
